quiz_title: Web Design Advanced - Quiz 1: Bootstrap & CSS Flexbox

questions.q: What tag is used to link the Bootstrap CSS framework from a CDN?
questions.exp: To link Bootstrap CDN stylesheets, we use a link tag inside the <head> section!

questions.q: Which parent display initializes the Flexbox layout system?
questions.exp: display: flex; tells the browser to arrange all direct children of this container as flexible items.

questions.q: Which property wraps flex items onto a new line when they run out of space?
questions.exp: flex-wrap: wrap; wraps child items to fresh rows dynamically as soon as container widths fill up!

questions.q: Which justify-content value distributes space evenly, leaving equal gaps between and around boxes?
questions.exp: space-around distributes items evenly, leaving standard spaces on both sides of each flex box!

questions.q: If flex-direction is set to column, how do elements stack?
opts: Vertically on top of each other
questions.exp: Setting column direction rotates axes, stacking boxes vertically like building blocks!
